title: Revisiting the marginal gap in the digital dental age – Clinical relevance of finish line location in IOS-based workflows compared to conventional workflows
html: Digital workflows have been increasingly being used in prosthodontics, but differences between conventional impressions and intraoral scans are still not fully understood. One important aspect is the finish line, as previous studies suggest that preparation margins captured with intraoral scanners (IOSs) are often located more coronally compared to those obtained from conventional impressions. While these vertical deviations can be quantified digitally, it remains unclear whether they are clinically detectable and which of the 2 finish lines represents the more accurate trueness.
